TC-08/S13.title: No email / mailto / share path on any handoff screen
TC-08/S13.detail: Local 8b4be94a, fresh @roundai.test accounts; no model: handoff/persistence:ensure answered at the Convex socket (ts 0, nothing scheduled), every ai/* refused, charts carry stored stand-in summaries re-inserted with `convex import --append` (ho-support.ts); tripwire 'no model call' on every run. Checked on Hospital and NH sheets, both Send dialogs, Handoffs → Sent and Received, sender and recipient details, the failed-summary sheet (S18) and after a failed send (S20): no mailto:/sms: link and no Email/Share/Forward control anywhere. Adapted to AC 10: the Send dialog now has a 'Colleague’s email' field (placeholder colleague@hospital.org) that only looks up an app account; the matrix's literal 'Email' / '@roundai.test' absence predates AC 10.
